meta.name: screen_elements
meta.description: 231 (plan stage A, A4; DECISIONS 231): the screen elements a process pack's tabs are built from. A shared element is one any process may use; a special element is registered once (with the capability whose step it shows) and from then on any process may use it too. A process pack naming an element not listed here is refused (jav/app/process_packs.py). The interface renders each type with one component (A6).

changelog.note: 231 (A4): the first set: the shared elements of the process packs and the three special elements of the quote's back half.
231 (A7e): the send step's handovers and the reply step's wait as special elements; the timeline and the cost shared elements get their data.
231 (B1): the partner link, a shared element: the partners a case is about, linked or proposed from its record.

data_table.what: A table from a registered dataset (columns, filters and links from the service).

field_review.what: A record's fields with their source on the page, each checked or corrected by a person.

form.what: A step's own form, from its capability's description.

document_view.what: A step's document: its pages, or the file it made.

approval.what: The approval of a step's result, with what holds it.

blockers.what: What holds a step or the case, each with where it is resolved.

actions.what: The step's actions, each with its cost cap when it may spend.

timeline.what: The case's events in order: who did what and when.

cost.what: What the case's steps spent, by step and service.

partner_link.what: The partners a case is about, by its pack's partner links: linked, or proposed from its record with the partner they seem to be.

record_view.what: A record put together from its parts, with the part each value came from and its gaps.

match_proposal.what: Each requested item's proposed catalogue item: sure, to check or not listed.

line_editor.what: The lines a person composes from the match, priced by code, with own prices and notes.

handover_view.what: What a send step sent: its mode, each attempt's file, recipient and outcome, and whether a person must say it arrived.

reply_wait.what: A reply step's wait: since when, when the follow-up opens, and the reply recorded.
